name: saes
description: Statistical evaluation suite for stochastic algorithms, automated hypothesis testing, and benchmark visualization.

tools.name: validate_benchmark_csv
tools.description: Validate experimental benchmark CSV files according to SAES schema rules.

tools.name: run_statistical_analysis
tools.description: Perform normality tests, Levene's test, automated test routing (t-test / Welch / ANOVA), and effect size calculation.

tools.name: check_assumptions
tools.description: Check Shapiro-Wilk and Levene assumptions for experimental groups.

tools.name: generate_distribution_plot
tools.description: Produce distribution plots (boxplots, violins, ECDFs, barplots).
